GAURAV BATRA

Gwalior | gauravbatra798@gmail.com||9179236878 | LinkedIn

SUMMARY

As a Programme & Delivery Management professional with 17+ years of experience, I have helped

leading banking, insurance and healthcare organisations deliver complex digital transformation,

regulatory and enterprise technology programmes across India, the UK, Europe, Hong Kong and the US.

In my most recent enterprise role, I delivered a time-critical Brexit-driven BaFin regulatory transformation

while improving operational efficiency by 25–30%, achieving 95%+ defect closure before go-live, and

establishing robust delivery governance through RAID, KPI, EVM, and release governance. My strengths

lie in stakeholder management, AI-enabled transformation and business-focused delivery.

SKILLS

Leadership & Delivery: Programme Management, Delivery Management, Digital Transformation,

Delivery Governance, RAID Governance, Stakeholder Management, Agile & Hybrid Delivery, Risk &

Change Management, Release Governance, Vendor & Client Management

Transformation & Technology: AI-enabled Transformation, Regulatory Transformation, Enterprise

Technology Delivery, Business Analysis, SDLC, Quality Assurance & UAT, KPI & EVM Reporting,

Business Process Improvement, Banking, Insurance & Healthcare Technology, AI Product Solutioning

EXPERIENCE

NATWEST GROUP INDIA PVT LTD/RBS SERVICES INDIA PVT LTD

India

Associate Vice President & IT Project Manager

Jan 2018 – Oct 2023

Spearheaded delivery of 10+ BaFin regulatory reports/templates within fixed 31 Mar 2019 regulatory

deadline through 6–7 stakeholder groups and 3 testing/UAT cycles with 95%+ defect closure.

Transformed the securitisation calculation process by migrating 100% of the impacted process from 1

Excel-based manual method to 3 system-based calculation approaches, improving operational

efficiency by an estimated 25–30% and eliminating an estimated 8–10 hours/month of manual effort.

Optimised client service turnaround time by an estimated 20–25%, digitising 12 physical forms,

reducing manual handling by an estimated 25–30%, physical printing by an estimated 50–60%, and

branch processing costs by an estimated 10–15% through a bank-wide e-Forms digitisation initiative.

Executed 1 end-to-end Disaster Recovery event, moving 1 critical platform to resiliency-proven status

over a 6–8-week execution window by validating recovery within agreed RTO/RPO targets.

Negotiated renewal of 3 vendor contracts at 0% fee increase, including 1 two-year renewal, achieving

an estimated 5–8% annual cost avoidance through stakeholder alignment before contract expiry.

HCL TECHNOLOGIES LTD

India

Project Lead/Project Manager

Jul 2015 – Jan 2018

Championed enhancement of 1 regulated MPF SuperTrust Plus scheme impacting 1M+ members by

coordinating 40+ business requirements across 4 delivery workstreams and supporting 3 testing/UAT

cycles covering 150+ test scenarios with an estimated 95%+ defect closure before go-live.

Orchestrated delivery across 4 workstreams by coordinating business requirements, development,

testing/UAT and release readiness to support regulator-visible implementation timelines.

Devised executable business requirements across 40+ requirement items by translating stakeholder

needs into delivery-ready outcomes and supporting cross-functional implementation.

I also worked at GalaxE Solutions India Pvt Ltd, Computer Sciences Corporation India Pvt Ltd, and Tata

Consultancy Services Ltd in Project Leadership and Business Analysis roles from 2005 to 2014.

EDUCATION

Executive Programme in General Management – Strategy, Operations, & Marketing

Lucknow

Indian Institute of Management

2011 – 2012

Bachelor of Engineering – Electronics & Communication Engineering

Gwalior

ITM University

2000 – 2004

CERTIFICATIONS

Agentic AI, Jun 2026

Machine Learning Specialisation, DeepLearning.AI, May 2026

Generative AI for Everyone, Feb 2026

Project Management Professional (PMP), Project Management Institute (PMI)

Scrum Master Accredited Certification (SMAC), International Scrum Institute

AI PROJECTS

Automated Puzzle Book Publishing Platform (2026)

Architected and developed an end-to-end Agentic AI platform that autonomously generates, validates, formats, and publishes word search puzzle books for Amazon KDP.

Built AI-driven content generation workflows using Python and Groq API (Llama 3.3), automating theme creation, puzzle generation, quality validation, and print-ready publishing.

Technologies: Python, Groq API (Llama 3.3), Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, GitHub

HeartCheck – Cardiac Health Screening Platform (2026)

Designed and developed an interactive cardiac health screening and education platform featuring symptom triage, five-stage risk assessment, and an ASCVD 10-year risk calculator with South Asian adjustments.

Collaborated with a medical professional to validate clinical accuracy and deployed the solution on GitHub Pages.

Technologies: HTML5, JavaScript, GitHub Pages, Clinical Decision Logic

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Entrepreneurship & Consulting (Oct 2023 – Present): Remained professionally active through

entrepreneurship, consulting, business growth and AI-enabled product development.

Empactly | Founder | 2024: Conceptualised a performance management and incentive platform by

defining the MVP and validating the concept through stakeholder engagement.

Avenue Growth | Consultant – Business Growth & Strategy | Feb 2025 – Jul 2025: Advised start-ups

on GTM strategy, client acquisition, value proposition refinement and execution roadmaps.

Avasar Works | Growth & Partnerships Consultant/Lead | Aug 2025 – Jan 2026: Drove partnerships

across NGOs, CSR and enterprise clients by structuring pilot programmes, engagement models and

revenue frameworks.
